text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday groans after returning to 
the waiting room following the race...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You see, I was just thinking about how I 
can start winning.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I wanna stop this losing streak! I mean, I 
haven't been delivering any Marvelous at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want to get stronger. 
Trainer, what should I do?"
choice_data_list: Let's build up our efforts step by step!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, got it. Slow and steady, no 
rushing!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Every single step leads to tomorrow's 
Marvelous☆ All for an even bigger 
Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. Well then, please put together a 
training menu that's perfect for me!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We'll win next time! And deliver the 
marvelous! E-I-E-I, OOOOOOHHHH☆★☆
